sloka: न ब्रवीमि स्त्रियः सर्वा भरतस्यैव मातरम् ।अनर्थभावेऽ र्थपरे नृशम्से ।ममानुतापाय निविष्टभावे ।किमप्रियम् पश्यसि मन्निमित्तम् ।हितानुकारिण्यथवापि रामे ॥२-१२-१०३॥
transliteration: na bravīmi striyaḥ sarvā bharatasyaiva mātaram ।anarthabhāve' rthapare nṛśamse ।mamānutāpāya niviṣṭabhāve ।kimapriyam paśyasi mannimittam ।hitānukāriṇyathavāpi rāme ॥2-12-103॥

translations.english: O malicious one, O covetous one, O cruel one, O woman determined to torment me, what fault have you seen in Rama who is always devoted to the welfare of others?
